description:
At the academy, you recited two formulae until they came to you without a thought.

The first time you {{memorisee|memorise}} {{DISCIP-001|this Skill}}, choose two {{sort|Spells}} from the {{banque-commune}} that cost 2 {{energie}} or less. While {{DISCIP-001|this Skill}} is {{memorisee}}, so are those two {{sort|Spells}}. You do not have to buy them, and they take up no {{memoire}}.
